decisions.reason: This drain housing remains close to the firm's core drainage engineering and system compatibility knowledge, so accumulated learning since launch supports continued retention despite a somewhat less central strategic role than flagship shower products.
A floor-level shower drainage system sits at the heart of the firm's core market and future direction, making it highly related to existing know-how and very unlikely to be withdrawn.
As the firm's design-oriented flagship shower drainage line, it strongly matches both strategic focus and internal development capabilities, so management would continue to back it.

The shower element with integrated slope builds directly on the firm's installation, waterproofing, and renovation expertise, which gives it strong absorptive capacity to refine and support the product.

Although less central than premium bathroom shower lines, the backflow-protected basement floor drain still fits the firm's drainage problem-solving competence for technically demanding applications and is therefore more likely to be kept than dropped.
